notes.title: BLACK GOLD demo Update - What’s New?
notes.content: [p][b]BLACK GOLD Update - What’s New?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Drillers![/p][p]We’re excited to announce the latest improvements and give you a sneak peek into our upcoming expanded demo![/p][p][/p][h3]Current Changes:[/h3][p]· ✅ [b]Improved Save/Load System:[/b] We’ve enhanced the stability and reliability of your saved games. Your drilling empire is safer than ever![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39450938/9e295bd49fb615815e7bdc25a5ae9e753911eaab.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Upcoming Expanded Demo:[/h3][p]Stay tuned—soon you’ll experience an even bigger slice of BLACK GOLD![/p][p]In the expanded demo, you’ll discover:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]🔩 [b]Metal Deposits:[/b] Uncover valuable metal resources crucial for your operations.[/p][/*][*][p]⛏️ [b]Pickaxe:[/b] Equip your workers with new tools to extract resources effectively.[/p][/*][*][p]🛢️ [b]BIG PUMP:[/b] Introducing a standalone, high-capacity oil pumping structure.[/p][/*][*][p]🏗️ [b]Construction System:[/b] Build and customize new structures essential for growth.[/p][/*][*][p]🛢️ [b]Oil Silo:[/b] Store vast amounts of oil securely for future processing.[/p][/*][*][p]🛒 [b]Expanded Shop Items:[/b] Including connecting pipes for BIG PUMP and the Oil Silo, plus additional useful items.[/p][/*][*][p]🚛 [b]New Oil Truck:[/b] A specialized vehicle to efficiently transport oil from your silo.[/p][/*][*][p]👷 [b]New Workers:[/b] Boost your drilling operations with fresh manpower.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39450938/3086d8dca422145ec0509fffd5b2304af57084fa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Long-term Development Goals:[/h3][p]We are hard at work on several major additions:[/p][list][*][p]🌙 [b]Playable Night Cycle:[/b] Experience drilling operations in fully playable nighttime environments.[/p][/*][*][p]🚂 [b]Train Unlocking:[/b] Integrate rail transportation to boost logistics and resource movement.[/p][/*][*][p]⚗️ [b]Oil Refinery System:[/b] Convert crude oil into various refined products, adding new layers of depth.[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Electricity System:[/b] Power your operations and expand into exciting electrical advancements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39450938/83bc2f41eb7790cb6600e2caad2e8f09d4f19969.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support—your feedback drives us to keep improving BLACK GOLD. Keep an eye out for the expanded demo release coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Drilling![/p][p]The Oil Man[/p]

notes.title: "Pet Your Dog" Black Gold Demo Update
